name: diarie brand tokens
note: Off-script tokens/styles-only sync — diarie has no component library, so the bundle carries the token layer, the two self-hosted fonts, the brand prose, and ONE preview card. `shape: custom` is off the skill's two standard shapes, so there is no stock converter: `.design-sync/build.mjs` IS the converter. Run `node .design-sync/build.mjs [outDir]` (default ./ds-bundle, gitignored), then upload outDir. It derives everything from tracked files — brand/tokens.css, brand/tokens.json, brand/fonts/, brand/foundations.css (shipped as the bundle's styles.css, with its @import re-pointed) and brand/foundations.html (adapted into components/foundations/Foundations/Foundations.html) — plus the hand-authored prose under .design-sync/bundle/ (README.md, guidelines/identity.md). BRAND.md and brand/DESIGN.md are NOT shipped; the bundle prose is its own artifact. Every rewrite is guarded and every outcome positively asserted, because no gate covers this path. The first sync (2026-07-19) was assembled by hand into a scratchpad and its recipe had to be recovered from the live project a week later; build.mjs exists so that cannot recur. Still no _ds_sync.json anchor, so a re-sync re-verifies everything — correct for this shape. Source of truth: brand/ in this repo.
